The '''''Unrepentant''''' was a [[Bulwark Mark I]] [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser]] that served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] as [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Dua Ningo/Legends|Dua Ningo's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] in the [[Bulwark Fleet]]. The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was destroyed during the [[Battle of Anaxes (21 BBY)|Battle of Anaxes]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].
